client_lines_tagged_to_name: locale:130452 [npc_dialog | - | Bears] "What's wrong?! Never seen a bear before?"
locale:130453 [npc_dialog | - | Bears] 'I heard bear eat robgoblins. Dangerous beast!'
locale:130454 [npc_dialog | - | Bears] 'Where have you heard that?? They like fish and berries and the last thing they want to eat is a robgoblin. Sheesh.'
locale:130455 [npc_dialog | - | Bears] "Still, they big and ugly! Don't like bears!"
locale:130456 [npc_dialog | - | Bears] "Oh, hush! You just don't like anything."

locale:432461 [quest_dialog | - | bears] "Thanks a bunch! I'm glad those bears didn't get into any trouble!

summary: An official Free Realms news post introducing the Durango Zoo on the northern banks of Lakeshore, run by Zookeeper Sam Durango. It describes the zoo's unfenced design, its wild animals (bears, antelope), and NPC Mr. Miles, who handles dangerous animals and nee (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=873)

fact:npc: Mr. Miles at the Durango Zoo keeps dangerous animals away from visitors and needs help because of the no-fence policy, especially with wandering bears. | It's his job to keep the dangerous animals away from the visitors and he always needs help (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=873)
